nom: Drunk Elephant O-Bloos Rosi Blush Drops

segments.dry: The couple of reviewers with dry skin say the drops work well and feel moisturizing rather than drying or heavy.
segments.sensitive: Several reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive or reactive say the fragrance-free formula feels calm and gentle with no redness or irritation, including ones who were specifically wary of a reaction.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, slightly oily skin says the formula isn't greasy and has a silky texture.
segments.mature: One reviewer notes the dewy, fresh finish is especially flattering on mature skin.

concerns.redness: Reviewers describe the formula as calming, with no redness or irritation reported even on sensitive or reactive skin, though one reviewer cautions against blending it with other lotions if you're prone to allergic reactions.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers cite the omega fatty acids and antioxidants in the formula as replenishing or supporting the skin barrier while adding color, though these are mostly ingredient-based observations rather than a described before-and-after change.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers, including one who calls her skin acne-prone, report the drops have not caused any breakouts or irritation with regular use.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say the omega-rich formula leaves skin feeling hydrated and soft rather than drying, and one uses it specifically to help keep her skin hydrated through the day.

aspects.libelle: Blends invisibly for a natural finish
A little goes a long way

extraits.texte: The Drunk Elephant O-Bloos Rosi Drops gifted by Drunk Elephant are an easy to use liquid blush. As someone with fair-light, neutral skin this gives a very light pink flush that looks natural. I used these by dotting a small amount across my cheeks and using my fingers to blend out. I tried with a brush as well, and both methods had great results that looked seamless and did not disturb my foundation underneath. This has a luminous finish that is smooth on the skin and does not enhance any lines or settle into pores the way powder formulas do. This shade is quite sheer and while I did try adding extra layers to build up the intensity, the result is still quite natural and I would not be the best option for those who want a noticably blushed look. Since the pigmentation is so light, I also would recommend trying these in a store, if possible, to see if they would work for your skin tone. I did not experience redness or irritation from this product on my somewhat sensitive skin. These Rosi Drops work great on my dry skin and I am happy to add them into my daily routine.

I was gifted by Drunk Elephant for the blush drops. I used them on my acne prone skin & no breakouts, which I appreciate. The finish is dewy and blends well, but the color is super sheer. Pretty for a soft flush, but don't expect major pigment.

It's a multipurpose masterpiece! I absolutely love my Rosi drops! Most days I use it to brighten and highlight my cheeks! It's great for the instant glow! It gives me that beautiful and radiant flushed cheek! I also like to use this with my moisturizer for a full face radiance! It makes my skin look healthy and beautiful! I have reactive skin and these are so gentle! They are lightweight and very comfortable! I have to have it for my daily glow! It's a wonder complimentary from Drunk Elephant!

extraits.titre: Beautiful shade and must have in makeup routine!
extraits.texte: These Rosi Glow Drops from Drunk Elephant are a must have, the shade is so beautiful, pigmented, stays on all day and it worked well for my dry skin type. I like the bottle/applicator because it makes it easy to use, the scent is minimal which I like and it lasts a long time because each drop is so pigmented so a little goes a long way. This was gifted by Drunk Elephant and I can't wait to try more products from them.

Talk about the most perfect and natural summer glow! Just 2 drops and your face looks elevated, glowing and just healthy. They're not greasy and have the most silky texture, even for my combination slightly oily skin. Such a gorgeous product for anytime of year! Kindly gifted by Drunk Elephant.

This is my first time trying the O-Bloos Rosi Drops gifted by Drunk elephant and honestly, it's one of the best liquid blushes I've tried, especially because it gives a very natural color. From the first time I used it, I noticed that it has a very smooth and light texture. When it touches the skin, it glides on easily and blends very well with just my fingers. I love everything about the shade—it's a very natural pink with a bit of glow, and it makes my skin look fresh and healthy. But what I really like about this blush are the ingredients. It's enriched with omega fatty acids, which give my skin deep hydration and leave it feeling soft. I definitely recommend it to anyone who wants a natural look and likes to use clean products that also give benefits to the skin.

This is more than just blush—it's a subtle skin-enhancing glow in a bottle. O-Bloos™ melts right into the skin, leaving a soft, rosy tint that looks like it's coming from within. It blends beautifully with skincare or makeup and adds the perfect touch of healthy color. Bonus: it's packed with antioxidants, so your skin gets a little love too. A little goes a long way, and the finish is fresh, dewy, and super flattering—especially on mature skin. Gifted by drunkelephant

reserve: This is a tinted color product, so most reviews focus on shade, pigmentation, and application rather than skin type or specific skin concerns; the segments and concerns above rely on a smaller number of incidental mentions rather than sustained before-and-after reports.
